notes: Source: SBV pages under "Hệ thống các TCTD" (https://sbv.gov.vn/vi/h%E1%BB%87-th%E1%BB%91ng-c%C3%A1c-tctd), each stating figures as of 30/09/2026 (list pages published 16-19/10/2026). Names are copied as shown on the SBV pages (including inconsistent casing); legalNameEn is the English name shown in the list where present. licenseNumber is the current/most recent licence shown on the list; many 2026 dates are re-issued licences (cấp đổi), not original founding dates. For TNEX the legalName keeps the SBV text including the "tài chính cộng đồng cũ" (former name) remark. Bank websites are null because the SBV bank pages do not list them (finance-company websites come from the SBV list's website column). Aliases are limited to names visible on the SBV list or its website column; common nicknames not shown there (e.g. OCB, MSB, SeABank, ABBank, PVcomBank, and "$NAP" for FE Credit) were deliberately NOT added because the SBV pages do not confirm them; add after checking each institution's own site. Ids vietinbank, bidv and vietcombank were assigned from the English legal names on the list. CLASSIFICATION: SBV lists only Agribank under NHTM Nhà nước; Vietcombank, BIDV and VietinBank appear under NHTM Cổ phần. The cổ phần page also lists TNHH MTV banks with zero charter capital (Vikki Bank, MBV, GPBank, VCB Neo), which the page does not explain; a footnote says VCB Neo was formerly Ngân hàng TNHH MTV Xây dựng. Other visible renames, not independently researched: Sacombank's legal name appears as "Ngân hàng TMCP Sài Gòn Tài Lộc", LPBank as "Ngân hàng TMCP Lộc Phát Việt Nam". FINANCE COMPANY CHANGES in the 30/09/2026 list: Lotte converted from specialised to general finance company (QĐ 1968/QĐ-NHNN 28/8/2026) with a name amendment (QĐ 119/QĐ-QLGS6 28/8/2026); SFinance received new licence 43/GP-NHNN on 10/7/2026 after a legal-form conversion (website shbfinance.com.vn); AEON had a name change (QĐ 2882/QĐ-QLGS6 24/10/2025); MB's finance arm is listed as "MB Shinsei Consumer Credit Finance" (old name Công ty tài chính TNHH MB; website mcredit.com.vn); VietCredit is listed as a general finance JSC (old name Xi Măng); FE Credit is listed as VPBank SMBC Finance (licence 69/GP-NHNN 20/10/2021 after legal-form change). Home Credit is still listed as operating on 30/09/2026; ownership is not covered by the SBV list and was not researched here. SKIPPED categories valid for category "bank" but not collected: Ngân hàng Chính sách xã hội (policy bank), Ngân hàng Hợp tác xã (Co-op Bank). SKIPPED because they do not fit the schema categories: công ty cho thuê tài chính (leasing), tổ chức tài chính vi mô (microfinance), quỹ tín dụng nhân dân, chi nhánh ngân hàng nước ngoài (foreign bank branches), văn phòng đại diện. Counts: 47 banks (1 state-owned, 34 under the NHTM Cổ phần heading, 10 foreign 100%-owned, 2 joint venture) and 16 finance companies.
